rows.note: This is the neutral all-purpose choice for a politician or politically prominent person.

example.english: This politician often goes into the community to chat with residents.
example.traditional: 呢位政治人物成日落區同市民傾偈。
example.jyutping: ni1 wai2 zing3 zi6 jan4 mat6 seng4 jat6 lok6 keoi1 tung4 si5 man4 king1 gai2

rows.note: Use this when criticizing a politician or suggesting opportunism, partisanship, or self-interest.

example.english: This politician will say anything for votes.
example.traditional: 呢個政客為咗選票，乜都講得出。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 zing3 haak3 wai6 zo2 syun2 piu3 mat1 dou1 gong2 dak1 ceot1

rows.note: Use this formal term for a recognized politician or political figure, especially in writing rather than casual speech.

example.english: The politician promoted numerous reforms during their term.
example.traditional: 該政治家在任內推動了多項改革。
example.jyutping: goi1 zing3 zi6 gaa1 zoi6 jam6 noi6 teoi1 dung6 liu5 do1 hong6 goi2 gaak3
